sections.brief: The case that the 1982 invasion and the occupation created the conditions: Barak, Rabin, the 1985 detentions, Norton; Hezbollah's own founding account; all labelled as argument. Figures: time.

The case that it would have formed anyway: al-Sadr and Amal, the Najaf and Dawa networks, Iran's export of the revolution and the IRGC; Shapira/ITIC and Qassem; comparison with Hamas Part Three and with Iran-aligned activity where Israel did not occupy; what cannot be known. Figures: flow; compare.
